name: markdown-wiki-links
description: Obsidian-style [[wiki-links]] between Markdown files in the workspace.

scripts.pretest: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm compile:tests

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Wiki-link click-to-follow, hover, completion, and preview embeds work in untrusted workspaces. Rename-aware link rewriting is disabled until the workspace is trusted (it modifies files on disk).

commands.title: Wiki Links: Scan Workspace for Broken Links

wikiLinks.embed.maxDepth.description: Maximum recursion depth when expanding nested ![[...]] embeds in the Markdown preview. Beyond this depth an embed renders a depth-exceeded notice instead of expanding.

wikiLinks.indexMaxFiles.description: Soft cap on indexed files. A workspace above the cap shows a notification and only the first N files are indexed.

wikiLinks.hover.imageMaxHeight.description: Maximum height (px) for image previews in hover popups. VSCode does not expose its hover height limit to extensions: lower this if previews are clipped, raise it if there is empty space below the image.

wikiLinks.index.excludeFolders.description: Folder names excluded from the wiki-link index. Any file inside a folder with one of these names is not indexed, so wiki-links never resolve into vendor or VCS directories. Match is on the folder name, at any depth. Rename link-rewriting skips these folders too.
